violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MEATBALLS AT 47F, SAUSAGE CRUMBLES AT 45F, AND STRING CHEESE AT 48F IN THE THREE-DOOR PREP TOP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION AND MOVED ALL OTHER TCS FOODS IN THE BOTTOM PORTION OF THE UNIT TO THE WALK-IN COOLER. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED BOTTOM PORTION OF THE THREE-DOOR PREP TOP AT 49F WITH EHS THERMOMETER, 50F WITH THERMOMETER IN THE UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC MOVED OR DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS IN THE BOTTOM PORTION OF THE UNIT. EHS SPOKE WITH OWNER AND A REPAIR TECHNICIAN IS GOING TO REPAIR THE COOLER ON 7/25/26. PLEASE PROVIDE REPAIR INVOICE TO EHS AND SEND SPECIFICATIONS OF A NEW REFRIGERATOR TO THE EHS PRIOR TO PURCHASING (IF THE ESTABLISHMENT WISHES TO REPLACE THE CURRENT COOLER).

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the sink basin at the 3-vat sink. THE PRESCRAPE HOSE HAS BEEN HUNG UP WITH THE SHELF ABOVE THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. PLEASE ENSURE THE PRESCRAPE HOSE IS EITHER SHORTENED OR THE SPRING IS EXTENDED TO ENSURE IT ALWAYS REMAINS ABOVE THE FLOOD LEVEL RIM. FOR THE TIME BEING, PLEASE ENSURE THE PRESCRAPE HOSE IS ALWAYS HUNG UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED FLOORS AROUND EQUIPMENT, SINKS, AND BATHROOM IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE INCREASE CLEANING FREQUENCY OF FLOORS THROUGHOUT THE ESTABLISHMENT.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the FRONT KITCHEN is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINK IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
